“Incredible! The prototype sailed right past those League ships and they didn’t bat an eye! This cloaking tech’ll be an ace-in-the-hole for NovaCorp.”

So this ship was cloaked and invisible for centuries. Eventually the device failed.

"Incrível! O protótipo passou navegando bem diante daquelas naves da Liga e elas nem piscaram! Esta tecnologia de camuflagem será um trunfo na manga para a NovaCorp."

“The ship will fly once more, and can be cloaked. I’ve also discovered that by tinkering with the device's parameters I can increase the cloak size to cover a vast area - though the field becomes unstable, and can only fool sensors, not the naked eye.”

Suddenly {HeadOfMil} and {HeadOfSec} burst into the workshop. “I heard of this incredible ship,” one cries: “ it would clearly be of more use to our military division!”

“No, security!”

Subitamente {HeadOfMil} e {HeadOfSec} irrompem na oficina. "Ouvi falar desta nave incrível," um grita: "ela claramente seria de mais utilidade para a nossa divisão militar!"

"Não, para a segurança!"
